The '''Great Protector's Gladiatorial Festival''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] celebratory event. Held on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], the event was boycotted and protested by the pacifist [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Veedo Vaocan]].
